name: prims_ts_block_sparse_wrapper_h8_kv8_d128
description: Reusable PrimTS block-sparse MHA/GQA/MQA attention over compact BSHD Q/K/V and live per-KV-head BSR metadata. Block geometry and mask type are retained by plan() and represented as optional trace context.

num_q_block_offsets.description: Number of BSR row offsets per batch and KV head.

num_block_indices.description: Capacity of the runtime KV-block ID tensor.

num_kv_valid_words.description: Number of optional token-validity words per batch.

constraints: mask_type is None or mask_type in ('dense', 'causal')

block_indptr.description: Absolute offsets into live block_indices for this wrapper run.

block_indices.description: Runtime KV-block ID capacity; only entries referenced by block_indptr are live.

kv_valid_bits.description: Batch-only token validity bits: token t uses bit t % 32 of word t // 32 (LSB-first); one means valid. Padding bits beyond the planned K/V capacity are ignored.

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
